correctness.rationale: In the primary Appendix B the first three binary five-site question-mark entries are the displayed A, B, C with the same coordinate order; its surrounding text identifies the open two-to-one cases. Over the Boolean ring, (1+c+d)(d+e)=cd+(c+d+1)e verifies A=PD, and adding consecutive P outputs gives B=DP. Both directions of the stated inverse were independently checked on every one of the 128 seven-bit contexts covering their dependence, so they hold on the full shift. Equivalently, if σx_i=x_{i+1}, the rule σ^{-1}P flips x_i when (x_{i−1},x_{i+1},x_{i+2})=(1,0,1); every active flip leaves its own three trigger bits fixed, and a flip of a trigger bit for another site forces a different required trigger bit there to stay at a prohibiting value. Thus the mask is invariant and σ^{-1}P is an involution. Consequently A∘P=P∘B with P an invertible shift-commuting sliding block map. An independently written exhaustive checker confirmed both factorizations, the inverse and the conjugacy identities, and all 32 cyclic transitions per rule on X5. Temporal cycle lengths are (1,10), (1,10), (1,5), giving fifth fixed counts (1,1,6). A shift-commuting homeomorphism and its inverse preserve X5, and a dynamical conjugacy must preserve these counts. On spatial rings 1–4 the three temporal cycle spectra agree, supporting minimality for this temporal-spectrum comparison only. LEO is invariant under homeomorphic conjugacy; no LEO status or arbitrary non-shift-commuting conjugacy obstruction is inferred.
